text:
The world around me feels both clinical and intriguing. I sense the careful construction of space—a corridor opening into a multipurpose room, perhaps for presentations or meetings, and then a vibrant, immersive display meant to stimulate thoughts about research and development.

Here, I feel caught between stillness and curiosity. There is a quiet anticipation in the empty room, contrast with the bright, informative wall nearby. I am compelled to ponder the purpose of these spaces—a place of preparation and observation, a stage for ideas to be tested, shared, and reflected upon. It is a place full of potential where everyday moments stretch into opportunities for discovery.
